rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an example or comparison that clarifies an idea.

example.english: I’ll use a real-life illustration to explain it, and then you’ll understand.
example.traditional: 我用個生活例子講解畀你聽，你就會明白。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 go3 saang1 wut6 lai6 zi2 gong2 gaai2 bei2 nei5 teng1 nei5 zau6 wui5 ming4 baak6

rows.note: Use this for a picture included in a book or publication, especially one that decorates or accompanies the text.

example.english: This book has an illustration on every page.
example.traditional: 呢本書每一頁都有一幅可愛嘅插圖。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 syu1 mui5 jat1 jip6 dou1 jau5 jat1 fuk1 ho2 oi3 ge3 caap3 tou4

rows.note: Use this for an explanatory diagram or visual explanation rather than a mainly decorative picture.

example.english: The manual includes an illustration, so it is much easier to understand.
example.traditional: 份說明書加咗個圖解，睇落易明好多。
example.jyutping: fan6 syut3 ming4 syu1 gaa1 zo2 go3 tou4 gaai2 tai2 lok6 ji6 ming4 hou2 do1
